items.title: Greg Abel Nearly Doubled Berkshire’s Lennar Stake and Added a $689 Million IPO Position
items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.

items.title: Berkshire almost doubles stake in tumbling housing stock
items.summary: The move gives Berkshire a larger position in the homebuilding industry.

items.title: Greg Abel Makes His Next Moves: Inside Berkshire’s Q3 Portfolio
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's Q3 13F shows it nearly doubled its Lennar stake to $2.1 billion, added Bending Spoons, and cut VeriSign and Capital One Financial holdings.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s Successor Greg Abel Is Doubling Down On His $2 Billion Bet That The American Dream Is Not Dead
items.summary: Mortgage rates top 7%, buyers can't qualify, and homebuilder margins are shrinking. Yet Berkshire keeps buying builders, and its new CEO admits the road will be bumpy. What does he see that the housing market doesn't?

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Lennar Stock?
items.summary: As Lennar has lagged behind the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a bearish outlook about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Homebuilder Confidence Just Fell to Its Lowest Since 2012
items.summary: Builders are giving up margin to keep buyers walking through the door, yet the stocks just rallied as if nothing was wrong. One traffic number suggests next season's orders are already in trouble, and one price level could decide whether Wall Street catches on.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) Reveals New Stake And Nearly Doubles One Holding
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRK.B) has disclosed a new stake in Bending Spoons, the parent of AOL, in its latest filing. The conglomerate has nearly doubled its holding in homebuilder Lennar, signaling increased capital allocated to the housing sector. Other positions across Berkshire Hathaway's equity portfolio were adjusted, with several holdings trimmed and others expanded in the same update.
